items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: The symphony is in two movements: the first is built on canons, and the second is a set of seven variations. Boulez’s Berlin recording has clear orchestral detail, a quality singled out by BBC Music Magazine.

links.title: Deutsche Grammophon — Boulez and the Berliner Philharmoniker, complete Symphony on Boulez Conducts Webern III

items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: The three piano movements are all drawn from a single twelve-note row. Webern wrote the finale first. Greg Sandow compared Zimerman’s warm playing of the work with Chopin and counted it among the best performances in the set.
